chunks: He said: "What is then your business, O messengers?"
ai.seo_question: What did God ask the messengers in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Mursalat, this rhetorical question serves as a divine inquiry into the purpose of the messengers' arrival, often interpreted by Shia exegetes as highlighting the humility of the angels and prophets before the Creator. It underscores the theological principle that even the highest servants act solely by divine command, reinforcing the theme of divine authority and the inevitability of the Day of Judgment.
